description: Update part of an instance's configuration (like `clerk config patch`). Values you send are deep-merged into the current configuration and apply to the live instance immediately; top-level keys you leave out are unchanged. Returns the before and after values of the changed keys and the new config_version. Run with dry_run first to validate and preview the change. Setting connection_oauth_apple.bundle_id for native Sign in with Apple needs a matching iOS app, so register it first with create_ios_application.

config.description: Configuration keyed by top-level config key, in the shape get_instance_config returns. get_instance_config_schema lists the valid keys and fields.

destructive.description: Allow changes that delete resources instead of resetting them: session templates, custom OAuth providers, and minimum app versions (a null entry or platform in native_app_minimum_versions).

dry_run.description: Preview the change without applying it.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

name: patch_instance_config
title: Patch instance configuration
